request.task: T3C2 definitive closure for live Canvas Agent Studio oracle
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

audit.proof_assessment: No runtime proof artifacts were supplied. Verdict is from static review of scripts/e2e/canvas-contract.mjs only: the Agent Studio path now threads a live data-edit-id, drives roster/form by keyboard, parses computed outline RGBA, registers a bounded waitForRequest before Enter, holds/counts POST-only via route, checks the seven JSON keys and editId absence in body/headers/empty query, asserts held-state disablement and the duplicate-request/postCount=1 oracles, always release/unroute in finally, and repeats retained hidden/aria-hidden/inert/0x0 plus a wraparound Tab cycle and state restore for tool switch and View/Edit.
residual_risks: assignment/dataClass held-state uses Playwright isDisabled() (true for aria-disabled) rather than the native disabled property used for radios/modes; an aria-only freeze would still pass
editId substring checks omit the POST pathname and can miss escaped/encoded forms
Tab-cycle wrapped=true can be satisfied by a small focus trap or a no-move Tab; iframe tab stops can also prevent wrap (false red) or freeze parent activeElement
parseColor treats missing alpha as 1 and would misread percentage alpha if computed style were not canonical rgba
QA Challenger isChecked after five ArrowRights does not first assert a different radio was selected
duplicate waitForRequest(750ms) is a timing oracle; postCount=1 through result is the real backstop
retained count() is one-shot with no waitFor on [data-retained-agent-studio]
